name: – Nacho Sánchez Amor – After § 26 – Am 35
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Türkiye
part_text: 26a. Expresses concern over restrictions affecting Christian communities, including obstacles to legal recognition, property rights and religious education; condemns antisemitism and antisemitic incitement in Turkish political discourse and state-affiliated media; calls on the Turkish authorities to protect religious minorities, combat antisemitism and uphold freedom of religion and belief;
